definitions.explanation: Lacking good judgment or sense; acting in an ill-considered or thoughtless manner. Often describes actions or decisions rather than inherent intelligence.

examples.japanese: {愚|おろ}かな{間違|まちが}いを{犯|おか}してしまった。
{彼|かれ}の{行動|こうどう}は{愚|おろ}かだった。
{愚|おろ}かにも、{警告|けいこく}を{無視|むし}してしまった。

notes:
CONJUGATION (as na-adjective):
・{愚|おろ}かな + noun ({愚|おろ}かな{行為|こうい} - a foolish act)
・{愚|おろ}かだ (predicative form)
・{愚|おろ}かに ({愚|おろ}かにも - foolishly)

USAGE:
Commonly modifies actions, decisions, or behaviors rather than people directly:
・{愚|おろ}かな{行為|こうい}/{行動|こうどう} (foolish action/behavior)
・{愚|おろ}かな{判断|はんだん} (unwise judgment)
・{愚|おろ}かな{考|かんが}え (foolish thinking)

COMMON PATTERN:
{愚|おろ}かにも〜 - foolishly did ~
This pattern emphasizes regret or self-criticism for an unwise action.

RELATED WORDS:
・{愚|おろ}かさ (noun form - foolishness)
・{愚|ぐ} (foolishness, in compounds like {愚痴|ぐち})

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ばか (stupid, foolish - more casual/direct)
・{馬鹿|ばか}げた (ridiculous, absurd)
・{浅|あさ}はか (shallow-minded, thoughtless)
